statements.attributed: The FT-IR spectra of the products synthesized from EG solution indicate the possible formation of metal hydroxide carboxylic compounds, which may be interpreted as M(OH)2−x·(CH3COO)x·nH2O
statements.quote: The FT-IR spectra of the products synthesized from EG solution indicate the possible formation of metal hydroxide carboxylic compounds, which may be interpreted as M(OH)2−x·(CH3COO)x·nH2O (M stands for Co, Cr, Fe, Mn, and Ni). The formation of this organic–inorganic hybrid compound could facilitate co-precipitation of the five metal cations at the nanoscale.

statements.attributed: The first weight loss (∼12.2 wt%) at 40–190 °C associated with a weak exothermic peak centered at 175 °C can be ascribed to the dehydration of the compound and/or release of absorbed water
statements.quote: When heated, for H2O–K/N, the first weight loss (∼12.2 wt%) at 40–190 °C associated with a weak exothermic peak centered at 175 °C can be ascribed to the dehydration of the compound and/or release of absorbed water. Another 10.4 wt% loss occurs at temperatures above 190 °C probably due to the decomposition of CO components. It should be noted that the TG curve of H2O–K/N demonstrates a continuous weight loss in the whole temperature range and no obvious TG plateau is observed.

statements.quote: Assuming that the weight loss in Stage I is ascribed to the removal of OH− and H2O and the weight loss in Stage II is ascribed to the decomposition of acetate groups, the estimated formula for the compound synthesized under EG-K/N and EG-K conditions is M(OH)1.41·(CH3COO)0.59·0.78H2O and M(OH)1.28·(CH3COO)0.72·0.12H2O, respectively.

statements.attributed: polyol-based metal hydroxides form to inhibit elemental segregation
statements.quote: Meanwhile, the polyol solvent plays a key role in inhibiting elemental segregation possibly through forming polyol-based metal hydroxides. It has been reported that reduction and hydrolysis are the main chemical reactions during the polyol process. The existence of OH− and acetate ions can facilitate the complexation of polyol with metal cations through deprotonating the hydroxyl group. A higher pH results in increased OH− and H2O contents in the as-synthesized HEHs.

statements.attributed: Scherrer equation is used to calculate crystallite size
statements.quote: The crystallite size calculated by using the Scherrer equation is 12.6 nm for HEH-1# EG-K/N.

statements.attributed: magnetic properties at low temperatures are due to multiple magnetic ions coupled antiferromagnetically with neighboring magnetic ones having different magnetic moments
statements.quote: The magnetic properties observed in the as-synthesized samples at low temperatures may be due to the presence of multiple magnetic ions coupled antiferromagnetically with neighbouring magnetic ones having different magnetic moments.

statements.attributed: ZFC-FC curves exhibit a peak indicating a transition from a magnetically blocked state to a superparamagnetic state
statements.quote: They are also similar to those of ZFC-FC observed for superparamagnetic nanoparticles; the ZFC curve exhibits a peak, indicating a transition from a magnetically blocked state (low temperature) to a superparamagnetic state (high temperature).

statements.attributed: blocking temperature increases as the volume of the particle increases
statements.quote: The blocking temperature increases as the volume of the particle increases, agreeing well with previous publications. The shapes of the ZFC curves could be explained by a magnetic anisotropy of magnetic domains and the inter-site exchange interactions among different metal cations at different sublattices. It requires further study to get a better understanding of the composition-metal species-magnetic property relationship, which is beyond the scope of this work.

statements.attributed: expanding the interlayer space of layered hydroxides enhances OER performance
statements.quote: Expanding the interlayer space of these layered hydroxides will enhance OER performance, which agrees well with previous reports. A relatively low Mn content in EG-K as-synthesized samples may be another reason for their reduced OER performance (Table 2).

statements.attributed: a unique 2D layered structure with defects and the multi-element synergistic effect are main factors responsible for excellent OER performance
statements.quote: A unique 2D layered structure with defects and the multi-element synergistic effect may be the main factors responsible for its excellent OER performance. Annealing these 2D HEHs leads to the reduction of their OER activity, possibly due to the collapse of layered structures and increase of crystallinity. For HEH-1# EG-K/N samples, the as-synthesized 2D HEM requires an overpotential of 300 mV to reach a current density of 10 mA cm−2, while that for the 200 °C- and 600 °C-annealed samples is 363 mV and 407 mV, respectively.

statements.attributed: annealing 2D high entropy glycerates leads to reduction of OER activity, possibly due to collapse of layered structures and increase of crystallinity

Annealing these 2D HEHs leads to the reduction of their OER activity, possibly due to the collapse of layered structures and increase of crystallinity.
